notes.title: Update v.1.1.0
notes.content:
Hello, this is the development team of The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily.

It’s been a little while since our last update, but today we’re excited to bring you a new patch featuring user-requested features and key bug fixes.
Thanks as always for your continued feedback and support!


[h3]▼ New Features & System Adjustments[/h3]
We’ve implemented several improvements including full controller support, double speed toggle, and more visibility during battles:

- Added controller support.
- Characters who retreated (HP hit 0) will now still gain experience after a victory.
- Implemented keybind customization options (gamepad not supported).
- Added a “2x Speed” toggle to battle speed options.
- Added a “Squad Details” screen accessible during battles to check unit stats and passive skills.


[h3]▼ Bug Fixes & Additional Tweaks[/h3]
- The Options menu now includes descriptions for each difficulty level at any time.
- Fixed an issue where certain tutorial images became overly pixelated at medium or low graphical settings.
- Fixed a line in the “Unite Episode” between Rubeus and Sapphirus where dialogue meant for Rubeus was mistakenly assigned to Sapphirus.
- Corrected a translation error in “Let's take a look!” where “Duke” was incorrectly displayed as “Baron.”
- In the Squad menu (bottom right), unit names will now auto-adjust spacing when name length exceeds the frame.
- Fixed an issue where only Scarlet and Lily were shown in the unit name display, now all ally units are shown.
- Long comments shown on the top-right of the main screen will now auto-adjust if they exceed the space.


[h3]▼ Playable Demo at TGS 2025![/h3]
We’re thrilled to announce that “The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily” will be playable at Tokyo Game Show 2025!

Thank you so much for all the encouragement and support! This opportunity wouldn’t have been possible without you.

If you’re attending, be sure to visit the One or Eight booth and give it a try!
Other Alliance Arts titles will also be featured so please look forward to it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/6ba01b6b57831436d469fb042509a058c0e7e99f.png[/img]

We’re deeply committed to improving the game based on your feedback and growing it into something even better.
Thank you for continuing to support The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily!

notes.title: Update v.1.0.2
notes.content:
Hello, this is the development team of The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily.

Since the launch of the full version, an incredible number of players have played the game, and we’ve been featured as one of the top releases of July 2025.
The entire team is deeply encouraged by this, and it’s all thanks to your warm feedback and support.
We sincerely thank you!

We’re carefully reading all your posts and reviews on the Community Hub, as well as livestreams and videos on social media and various platforms.
(We’re sure Lady Scarlet herself is watching your streams and smiling…!)

Today, we’d like to report on several bug fixes and balance adjustments.


[h3]▼ Fixes and Game Adjustments[/h3]
We received a lot of feedback about the enemies in the final act.
The goal was to create a structure where Scarlet and her allies grow stronger together to overcome overwhelmingly powerful enemies.
However, to enable smoother gameplay, we’ve made slight balance adjustments:

・Increased the number of followers gained after each battle in the final act
・Increased the number of followers gained after the speech event

By increasing public support faster, you can benefit from things like:
“higher starting MP in command battles” & “stronger forces in delegated battles.”
Skills that scale with follower count will also be more useful.

Examples:
- Scarlet’s passive skill “Crimson Banner” now heals more HP
- Lily’s EX skill “On the Stage” now has higher stun success rate
- Scarlet & Lily’s Unison Skill “Hold Me to Thy Bosom” now stuns more reliably

We’ve also made a few other fixes and adjustments:

・Minor animation tweaks to the Prologue tutorial battle
・In Act 2, simply unlocking the bypass route incorrectly triggered the “Great Wall detour” branch — this now happens only when you reach the bypass outpost


[h3]▼ Bug Fixes & Optimization[/h3]

Thank you for your patience. We’ve also carried out bug fixes and optimization.

- Revised memory management to reduce memory usage during gameplay
- Improved loading time when loading save data
- Fixed a progression-blocking issue where units could be placed beyond outpost capacity when Sanjay and Carmine or Primula and Jane joined simultaneously
- Fixed a bug where getting stunned before counterattacking in battle caused no damage and softlocked the game
- Fixed a UI bug where pressing multiple menu buttons at once on the main screen broke the layout
- Fixed issue in some enemy commander defeat scenarios where stats-up dialogs failed to advance
- Fixed an issue where backgrounds did not darken properly during skill enhancement scenes for some enemy commanders
- Fixed a delay in visual effects disappearing when switching from 3D to 2D maps
- Removed unintended frame rate cap settings from language/difficulty options during initial launch
- Fixed incorrect effect positioning for Scarlet & Primula’s Unison skill
- Fixed display issues with ground contact and effects for Uisce & Carmine’s bond skill
- Fixed incorrect camera positioning for Sanjay & Carmine’s Unison Skill
- Fixed temporary narrow FOV bug after Nicol’s panic scene when supply lines are threatened in Act 1
- Replaced the incorrect video for Strategy Dogma “Unit Movement II”
- Fixed Almeria’s skill “Here's the Truth” which stunned for 3 turns instead of the intended 1 turn
- Adjusted line spacing and other typography issues in Simplified Chinese
- Minor fixes to various localized text



We plan to continue releasing multiple updates for the full version, aiming for around September.
However, as we’re concentrating our resources on full version development, the differences with the demo version have become significant.

As a result, we have decided to end public availability of the demo version in order to focus fully on the full version.
We deeply apologize for any inconvenience caused.

We’d love to hear your thoughts and feedback via the Community Hub, reviews, or our official Discord!
(Of course, content creation is also welcome!)

Thank you again for your continued support of The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily!

notes.title: Director's Message: Current Issues and Upcoming Updates
notes.content:
Hello, this is the development team of The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily.

Since the official release, we've seen an incredible number of players enjoying the game. We deeply appreciate your warm encouragement and valuable feedback aimed at improving the game. Thank you very much!

We carefully examine every review, community hub post, livestream, and social media comment, and they greatly motivate our entire team.


[h3]▼ Current Issues Being Addressed[/h3]

We are currently preparing fixes for the following issues:

- Fix for an issue preventing deployment if no appropriate base exists when recruiting allies.
- Fix for unintended skill activation when Rebecca appears as an enemy unit.
- Fix for certain enemy units having slightly higher than intended stats in the final act.
- Fix for a progression issue occurring when skipping the stat boost sequence after defeating a General, causing Scarlet's status to increase.
- Fix for voice playback that occasionally doesn't stop in some scenario parts.
- Fix for the ★ blinking animation for base reinforcement not displaying correctly upon redeployment.
- Corrections for some localized text (English).

The above issues will be addressed in an update as soon as preparations are complete. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused to our players and appreciate your patience as we work swiftly to resolve these issues.


[h3]▼ Regarding Future Updates[/h3]

We have received many comments and suggestions regarding gameplay optimization. Updates will be rolled out progressively as soon as preparations are finalized. 

We will be adding the option below for the next immediate update.
・Option to set frame rate cap

Our team remains committed to deliver a better gaming experience and we greatly appreciate your understanding.


[h3]▼ Gameplay Tips[/h3]

Lastly, we’d like to highlight a few commonly overlooked points when facing strong enemies:

[b]- Stacking Support Skills [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/c75952e51632673a0d037b896622dfe47dca7404.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/eecf60c8c6ed7b42dc4f0eed4ef95c55968661eb.png[/img]

In our game's "Command Combat," support skills (buffs/debuffs) are highly effective. These effects can be stacked to further strengthen and amplify their effects. 

 (※The image above illustrates the changes when stacking Uisce's skill "Observation Correction.")

This strategy is particularly crucial in battles against strong enemies and useful for protecting allies who may have fallen behind in levels. Feel free to try it in-game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/52cad742d51e08b78663388966b32c73562119de.png[/img]


[b]- "Revolutionary" Attribute[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/c17bdd9e3c9e48992deaa1782c4f9473b12f9990.png[/img]

The Revolutionary attribute gives you an edge against standard troops (soldiers, gunners, cavalry). Make sure to take advantage of it in critical moments.


[b]- Checking Enemy Details[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/aa7c9d247d1fe43fc89520b2e41822b47eba5f68.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/edd49aa8ee3c284fb3d952d0ac62bdd55e6549e1.png[/img]

By right-clicking enemy icons on the map and selecting "Details," you can view detailed enemy information, including conditions for recruiting enemy Generals, parameters, and available skills. Please utilize this as a reference when planning your strategy.

While we recognize certain aspects of the game may still be causing inconveniences, our entire development team continues in striving to provide you with a more enjoyable gaming experience.

Thank you again for your continued support of "The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily."

We're also deeply grateful to share that the game has been downloaded over 15,000 times in just its first four days. Thank you gain to everyone who's joined us so far!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/9b30b14f44afab1fa8e4cd6f6a4dd8dd2c1c7251.png[/img]

notes.title: Director's Message: A guide for playing the game
notes.content:
Hello, this is the development team of The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily.

Thank you so much for waiting...
We’re so happy to announce that we have finally released the full version of the game.
This is entirely thanks to the warm feedback and countless messages of support we’ve received from all of you. We are deeply grateful from the bottom of our hearts.

Today, to mark the release of the full version, we’d like to take the time to once again highlight the game’s features and points of interest.


[h3]▼ Capture every enemy Commanders or Execute them![/h3]
The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily is a [b]turn-based strategy game[/b] where you lead the small rebel force the "Scarlet Army" in a daring challenge against the overwhelming might of the Empire.

Victory in this uphill battle depends on one thing: [b]infiltrating enemy territory swiftly[/b] and [b]capturing or defeating enemy commanders[/b].
This isn’t a game where brute force always wins the day. Instead, your success depends on devising strategies to outmaneuver the enemy using your limited forces.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/c3ced6fbd8d293363f5c2963dd67ac6da4393508.jpg[/img]

Will you [b]capture every enemy commander and recruit them[/b] to your cause to clear Scarlet’s name from the false accusation of assassinating the emperor?

Or will you [b]slaughter the commanders[/b] without hesitation, staining your hands with blood as you march toward the path of a Demon Queen?

We will be breaking down the gameplay system of the upcoming full version of the game, and explain some of the elements that may help you in experiencing this strategy game.


[h3]▼Build Supply Lines Against the Empire[/h3]
A key element of this game’s mechanics is the concept of “supply lines.”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/8100ef2cab716c0661eaa87985a6cb70aa58209a.gif[/img]

- Lines that [b]connect your Headquarters to your occupied outposts[/b] are called [b]supply lines[/b].
- Units stationed on supply lines [b]automatically receive healing (supplies) each turn[/b].

This lets you prepare offensives, hold out in long battles, and adapt your strategy as needed.

As long as an outpost is connected to the Head Quarter, it will [b]recover each turn[/b], 
meaning it is absolutely critical for the Scarlet Army's survival to [b]maintain supply lines[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/2e5d9f8b31d64badd2b6d73e058f0b6195777ea3.jpg[/img]

In other words, this game is all about [b]connecting, extending, and defending supply lines to defeat enemy commanders[/b].

Since the enemy has their own supply lines too, battles become a contest of how to preserve your lines while severing theirs.

This ongoing [b]struggle over supply lines[/b] is one of the core tactical systems in the game.


[h3]▼ You can’t protect everything... So what will you do?[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/98f632da523502d9039edaa4aea19382cce892cd.jpg[/img]
You’re constantly outnumbered. 
As your influence spreads, it becomes [b]impossible to defend every outpost[/b].
This is the harsh reality Scarlet faces as the leader of a rebel army.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/1bb32af8d80eb362584401cd6b989c4018b688a2.jpg[/img]

As you see here, you cannot defend all of the supply lines when being attacked from all sides...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/57f9821c0c1eaa65a0a451b3a46c82f66e1e0cfa.gif[/img]

But Scarlet has one powerful advantage. The [b]Stream Airship and Shows[/b].

These allow for powerful strategic effects across the map:
- Stall enemy movement
- Disrupt enemy supply lines
- Boost friendly unit mobility
- Lure enemies into traps
- Flip enemy bases to your side

Use these effects to manipulate enemy movement and secure your supply routes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/e4e83b15ca042b831da71b5e628b850a81ef695f.jpg[/img]

Also, Scarlet and Lily will stream all kinds of bizarre, fun shows from the stream airship, spreading propaganda to shake the morale of enemy troops!


[h3]▼ A War of Lines, Not Land[/h3]
[b]Bases are not your territory, but just a line for supplies[/b]
(There’s no policy management of sorts in this game)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/525e45673becc9a7d3cdd7a33c4b10f676b91cb4.jpg[/img]

Instead of expanding territory indiscriminately, your best bet is to spearhead a direct supply line to your target commander and force a short-term decisive battle.
That’s how the outnumbered Scarlet Army finds a fighting chance against the Empire.

[b]Your tactical choices—which outposts to hold or abandon, who to assign as the strike teams—is the heart of gameplay.[/b]

Anticipate enemy movements, abandon unnecessary posts, and rebuild supply lines to focus fire on the next commander.

This game is [b]not about conquest but a game about strategically capturing or eliminating key targets[/b].


[h3]▼ Delegate (auto-battle) or Command Battle: Your Choice[/h3]
The game progresses [b]taking turns between the enemy phase and the player phase[/b]. When you make contact with an enemy unit, the battle begins.

[b]Enemy turns can be sped up[/b] for smoother pacing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/192414ee2a652acb5a96b3a67aa01eb09b664b0f.jpg[/img]

When a battle begins, you can choose to [b]Delegate (auto-battle) or use Commands (player input)[/b]

Before the battle begins, you'll see a projected damage preview for both sides.
If the expected losses look too high for Delegate, you can take direct command to mitigate risk.
(Note: Auto-battle uses only standard attacks and does not trigger special skills.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/4dac59b38f4775a4a1f6359ff03d76f9d98b3059.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/16b3999b86c7fecb222c820c06173d84e7349636.gif[/img]

[b]If you take direct control, battles play out in a three-turn command battle system.[/b]

Each character learns and upgrades skills (tactics) with RPG-like progression.
As your army grows, [b]what you can do in three turns also expands.[/b]

Because of the three-turn limit, battles against powerful bosses may [b]not be resolved in a single engagement[/b].

That’s where wave attacks using multiple units in succession come into play. 
[b]Who goes in, and in what order[/b], becomes a core strategic decision.

You’ll also find growth and character relationship mechanics, including:
- [b]Leveling up from victories[/b]
- [b]Upgrading your unit size at certain levels[/b]
- [b]Building "trust" between units that fight together repeatedly[/b]

Build enough trust between units, and you’ll unlock special “Unison Skills” and character-specific "Unite Episode".

Befriend (capture) various commanders and enjoy building your own troops.


[h3]▼ Troop Count and Damage Output[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/9b03ec3952c56850419485c6290e68566e98da63.jpg[/img]
In this game, each character takes on the role of a [b]unit commander[/b], leading their own squad into battle.

Because of this, as their HP (horde points) decreases, the damage they deal also drops, making it harder to achieve results.

That’s why maintaining strong supply lines and entering battle in peak condition is key to victory for the Scarlet Army.

On the flip side, this also means cutting off enemy supplies and chipping away at their HP will weaken their attacks in turn.

Sever the enemy’s supply lines, and engage their commanders when your forces are at full strength —
Pave your own path to victory with the tactics of a true battlefield strategist!


[h3]▼ What fate awaits the two…?[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/c05ebb81653c0d594c16dde2516cbb8ff6ca1e6f.jpg[/img]
This game is [b]multi-ending[/b].

Will Scarlet and Lily choose to capture every enemy commander and bring them over to their side, in order to clear their names of the alleged emperor’s assassination?

Or will they cast aside all allegations and destroy the Empire themselves, without making a single ally?

There are a few other endings as well, but at its core, your choice to [b]capture all or reject them entirely[/b] will greatly impact the fate of the two protagonists.
For your first playthrough, we recommend aiming to either [b]capture everyone or execute everyone[/b], as that will let you fully enjoy the story.

Also, depending on [b]how and when you capture or execute[/b] each enemy commander, the characters' reactions and events will change in subtle ways.

Most of the story (including dialogue scenes) unfolds as a [b]fully voiced drama[/b], so if you enjoy the world, we hope you to try different choices!
(No matter how you play, the story will always move forward so not to worry!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/bae9df67cb8fdc339ccd6003e40b1574b74f4b6a.jpg[/img]

If you’re aiming to capture a specific commander, be sure to check their info screen. [b]Capture conditions are listed in the enemy information[/b], and you can plan your strategy accordingly.

Also, as mentioned in the previous story overview, Scarlet and Lily are [b]a fixed couple[/b] in this game.
(Sorry, there are no branching romance options based on choices)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/8f87f83011187d08400b1db851eb8dbee07d1950.gif[/img]

Instead, the game features a system where certain characters can build trust by [b]fighting and winning together[/b], gradually raising their “Trust Level.”

As Trust Levels grow, the pair will unlock special story episodes (Unite Episode) that explore their unique relationship, and may even learn powerful [b]Unison Skills[/b].

We hope you enjoy building relationships between your units and watching them grow together!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/8b2b865945441a3d1f649938ef118c837c808daa.jpg[/img]

Each character has two Unite Episode partners, and these combinations are listed in the character menu.
(If you try enough, it's possible to view all episodes without replaying the game)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/80b85022e6af956357db513a6a17ad76f0e34d47.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/cd65022d4e327d4c9ded8f796de9a34581c9d83f.gif[/img]

As you progress through these Unite Episodes, powerful Unison Skills will also be unlocked.


[h3]▼ Want a smoother experience?[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/8258b932da86c627a9f7bf097138c5dca7fc6ecf.png[/img]

When you first start the game, or anytime from the options menu, you can freely change the difficulty.

[b]Strategy Mode[/b]
　　A tactical challenge for those who enjoy carefully planning their moves. Great for players familiar with strategy games.

[b]Easy Mode
[/b]A mode designed for those who don’t usually play strategy games, with toned-down enemy stats.

There are no differences in content between difficulty modes, so we hope you’ll choose the one that feels most comfortable for you!



We hope this deep dive has been helpful!
(Sorry it got a bit long again…!)

The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily isn’t your typical land-expanding strategy game.
It’s a strategy game [b]focused on supply lines, and about a small rebel force facing off a massive imperial army[/b].

What kind of battle will Scarlet and Lily fight, and how will their journey end?

[b]Will they find a happy ending, or become feared as Demon Queens——[/b]

Our biggest joy would be for everyone to see the good ending of these two with your own eyes.

Please guide Scarlet and Lily to a happy ending!

We hope for your continued support for
『The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily』

notes.title: Director's Message: Regarding the Story of the Game　The Great Prologue ⑤
notes.content:
Hello!
This is the development team of The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily.

Many characters appear in front of Scarlet and her allies. Some stand in the way and some stand alongside...
In this edition of “The Great Prologue,”  Lady Scarlet and Lily-chan will be introducing the colorful cast of characters from the Empire.

We’ve greatly increased the amount of voiced lines compared to the demo, and hope to deliver a more immersive story.
 (*It’s not fully voiced, but they do talk quite a bit... I think!)
We’d be delighted if you imagine their voices and look forward to your encounters with them.

Now then—
Lady Scarlet and Lily-chan, take it away!


[h3]▼ The Kind Sister of the National Church[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/27a6cc8fa869267bbb11c493eb12fc0e3937772d.gif[/img]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/9e07582bacaceca5212ee5d05b6e67d3bdc54e2f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/d48b92dbe10bba51a330dc071712c37df4d78930.png[/img][/url]
Hm? A non-combatant?


[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/6d468b573741d4e5b4b6ddf4c5d9afe240075f36.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/18a999e7c751bb044ea356f39080b60f3f5760bf.png[/img][/url]
Apparently she’s a sister of the Empire’s National Church.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/b62e0621e07144a4584fc005e13a77d525db1371.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/b8c8d00ef665dd082352239b7e6119adec3cb55e.png[/img][/url]
Ah, the one Gwyn is close with.
I haven’t met her myself, but I’ve heard about her.


[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/6d468b573741d4e5b4b6ddf4c5d9afe240075f36.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/18a999e7c751bb044ea356f39080b60f3f5760bf.png[/img][/url]
Wow, that’s rare these days.
In the Republic, the separation of church and state has really progressed.


[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/ddaa6af065b327e160e530e9d3c1d49129e9cd86.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/d751eaa3e605528fa297ee682d5760ae2cd76df4.png[/img][/url]
Well, it’s a national religion. 
You can’t separate them.


[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/6d468b573741d4e5b4b6ddf4c5d9afe240075f36.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/18a999e7c751bb044ea356f39080b60f3f5760bf.png[/img][/url]
I wonder how close she is with Lord Gwyn?


[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/9e07582bacaceca5212ee5d05b6e67d3bdc54e2f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/d48b92dbe10bba51a330dc071712c37df4d78930.png[/img][/url]
She’s sometimes invited to local charity work,
 and other times acts as an advisor for policy-making.


[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/bde30e31bd3eb642a84fd59711ad88ca94852cc1.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/45baa7669f9b76748e5c1746acba81e070552b49.png[/img][/url]
Sounds like they’re really close.


[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/ddaa6af065b327e160e530e9d3c1d49129e9cd86.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/d751eaa3e605528fa297ee682d5760ae2cd76df4.png[/img][/url]
He should’ve just married her.


[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/38a9fba1d07889168623b8b03a02756c5c3186f7.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/9a8b4fe3ba27be930885c2442ced77e2248eb0bd.png[/img][/url]
You can’t marry a nun!
But wow… her neckline and shoulders are really...


[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/4b64723981fa7d86d57a02d08b605810114a812d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/a17720eee417cfc1e4841e65669225350d9bd2ef.png[/img][/url]
Is that really a type fashion for someone who’s taken a vow of chastity?


[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/70fd71689c4b5982142f1828e2a10f71150a9768.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/3cc3b107191e33bef3a55993c3bc0814fae24f30.png[/img][/url]
I guess even the prince is still a man, huh?


[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/a3e27e7c08a1c58ff065a1f99b2520a32aeb5b9b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/4c51645be8fa9f470b8709c62112e6dd3a23f140.png[/img][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/26d1367eb359f0846f5d240d842537f9ebb6b55d.png[/img]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/a6b8430e3fd2b571dad13c834ce4e42d7b261ec0.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/2026145c0260718f0ee84c4197b05bc009156d24.png[/img][/url]
Emmmmmmmm


[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/ddaa6af065b327e160e530e9d3c1d49129e9cd86.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/d751eaa3e605528fa297ee682d5760ae2cd76df4.png[/img][/url]
You’re traumatized just from being seem suspicions?

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/07713544384be9adab242c6a0c1cd400e899475e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/b6b8ed2a8f71dec60994819217e6ef30e6ad2707.png[/img][/url]
 What exactly do the Police Corps do?


[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/b62e0621e07144a4584fc005e13a77d525db1371.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/b8c8d00ef665dd082352239b7e6119adec3cb55e.png[/img][/url]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/6d468b573741d4e5b4b6ddf4c5d9afe240075f36.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/18a999e7c751bb044ea356f39080b60f3f5760bf.png[/img][/url]
Ah, so they’re also in charge of counterintelligence.


[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/ddaa6af065b327e160e530e9d3c1d49129e9cd86.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/d751eaa3e605528fa297ee682d5760ae2cd76df4.png[/img][/url]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/07713544384be9adab242c6a0c1cd400e899475e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/b6b8ed2a8f71dec60994819217e6ef30e6ad2707.png[/img][/url]
 …Is the Empire suffering with a personnel shortage?


[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/b2a93c6529f4da1011ef795b9d733f538327f674.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/0a99973423ed5351439dfde5b61336668e11f534.png[/img][/url]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/70fd71689c4b5982142f1828e2a10f71150a9768.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/3cc3b107191e33bef3a55993c3bc0814fae24f30.png[/img][/url]
Oh. So it’s their job to interrogate every suspicious person?
Guess that’s why we were suspects on the night of the incident... Just doing their job.


[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/23e780e2e54a38db08fa01e0171ac001ae439429.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/9798bc911aa6e2303560881a70f36eff079ad070.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Director's Message: "Capturing and executing enemies" & the future of the demo
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
This is the development team of The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lilly.

As development enters its final stages, the feedback and encouragement we continue to receive through reviews and the Community Hub have been an incredible source of motivation for the entire team. We extend our heartfelt thanks to all of you.

We also received a tremendous response to our previous update regarding "Trust Levels," and the development team is once again deeply grateful for the high level of interest in this title. Thank you so much.

Today we would like to give you a sneak peek of another element from the game to you.
A little introduction to [b]"Scarlet's decision" [/b]

*Please note that the details shared below are based on the current build of the full version and are subject to change as development progresses.


[h3]■ Capturing and Executing Enemies
[/h3]
Named characters such as Uisce, who was in the demo, can be captured when using Lily’s skill On the Stage while “Capture Stream” is done on the Stream Airship.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/0d0a2379d659d8a21ea5c3111a0c92d64986115e.png[/img]

“Capture Streaming” will be shown when On the Stage is active.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/e9595e91e97986b5f1505db0e274a6e98344303d.gif[/img]

When you successfully capture them, you can add them as an ally but some enemies need to meet special conditions to capture.
(You can check the conditions for adding an ally from the “UNIT” menu.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/2cfe499b5f7b7097d1c05674c1bc396136123472.png[/img]

On the other hand, you also have the option to destroy your enemy.
When you choose this, the enemy will not become an ally and will be executed.
[b]“Scarlet’s skills or status can be enhanced”[/b] when you choose to execute.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/bdbdaf3eaade9ee6d90db4fd6616ea58a8225d90.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/896bf784cb4eb49843e013cb3e84187134994265.png[/img]

Depending on the path you choose, there may be different outcomes you will encounter.
Will Scarlet & Lily journey together, alone?
Or will they go forth with new allies…
We hope you enjoy the choices that you make.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/18914ff7695b8228e91473bd9f0c0fda306499f5.png[/img]

(When you execute, you may see a different outcome.  Feast your eye on Scarlet's decision!)

[h3]■ Regarding the Future of the Demo[/h3]
At this time, we are fully focused on completing the full version of the game and we will be temporarily pausing updates to the demo.
We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

Additionally, several major changes have been made with the demo, and there are significant differences from the full game.
For this reason, [b]we plan to temporarily suspend distribution of the demo in the near future[/b], with the intent of re-releasing it at a later date with updated content that reflects the full version.
As a substitute during this period, we are currently preparing [b]a gameplay video covering the early stages of the game[/b], which we hope you will enjoy.

We apologize for the inconvenience and truly appreciate your understanding and patience.

We hope you enjoy The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily for the coming days.

Development Team

notes.title: Director Message: Regarding the relationships between characters
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

A huge thank you to everyone who played during the Steam Next Fest!

We also truly appreciate all the feedback and reactions to our previous Director's Message. The entire development team is truly grateful for your support.

Today, we’d like to briefly touch on the "Relationship system between characters," which has been a frequent topic in the Community Hub.

Please note that this feature is still in development for the full release, and specifications may change in the future.

Thank you for your continued support!

[h3]■ Earning Trust
[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/e17f35011a807f4b49d1409b6e317f84b40b8b9a.png[/img]

First off, we have decided to rename "Relationship" to "Trust" which should better convey the intent of the system.

Some characters can form a trusted relationship with specific allies.
You can check which characters you can build trust with in the Info Menu.
Trust levels increases when "characters fight together and win battles."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/80c8b1014b7a8d861a713f01199f5026c09516ab.png[/img]

(The trust progression can be checked on the results screen)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/e97f6c97480cbbea495dbdfeadf80f1d5eb1fac9.png[/img]

When the trust level between characters reaches a certain point, slice of life stories called "Unite Episodes" will be unlocked.
Each character has unique episodes, ranging from:

- Stories that deepen friendships
- Stories where their beliefs clash
Through these interactions, small but meaningful stories unfold.
(Sorry, no ecchi content in the game!)

Trust-building is not limited to female or male relationships, but please note that not all the stories will be romantic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/39d69e417354d9ada4546fae844f2c4e3ae9d7ac.png[/img]

These episodes are divided into multiple stages.
As you progress through these episodes, you will unlock "Unison Skills" that can be used in combat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/74539a9a7b4cc43c89934e3b990d5167778add7a.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/35db9876a1b28a780949408ebb79e4929442b9ce.gif[/img]
Unison Skills are powerful abilities unleashed through the cooperation of specific character pairs.
Strengthen your characters’ bonds and unleash their full potential!

I hope this clears things up a little!
Thank you again and we hope you look forward to the game!

notes.title: Director Message:The development progress being made for the full version
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
Thank you so much for continuing to play the demo after the update on January 21st! 
The entire development team is truly grateful for your support and feedback.

All of the comments and suggestions we received have been shared among the team and are being used as guidance to deliver a better gaming experience.

Today, we’re excited to give you a small sneak peek at some of the development progress being made for the full version! 
These features are not yet implemented in the demo, so we hope you look forward to the full release.

[h3]■ The Characters
[/h3]Through the Community Hub and reviews, we’ve received a lot of feedback about the characters.
Thank you so much!

You have met Scarlet and Liliy already, but there are more to come with 21 characters in total planned for the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/46eb1a7057c956ad0a54f59c47fea80ad59262db.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/5b7f620208cfc8b7adba694533c9616d36fa84b1.png[/img]
Additionally, by recruiting certain characters, you can unlock new "shows" to broadcast.
Each show has a unique impact on the battlefield, find out what effects there are by discovering new shows!
We hope you look forward to exploring them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/490512104ce7c532f5ea24a56c36c32cd10de5e7.png[/img]

Other character upgrades include:
　・Learning new skills upon leveling up (including skills that affect not only battles but also the battlefield)
　・Increasing trust levels with specific character combinations (leading to trust-related stories and combo moves)
with more planned.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/74539a9a7b4cc43c89934e3b990d5167778add7a.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/35db9876a1b28a780949408ebb79e4929442b9ce.gif[/img]

[h3]■ Regarding the Save Functions
[/h3]In response to the feedback we received about the save feature in the demo version, we are planning to implement the following 3 save functions to allow for more comfortable retries:

・More auto save slots
　You will be able to resume from multiple recent checkpoints.
・Restarting from the beginning of each act
　You can restart at the beginning of each "act" that marks a key chapter in the story.
・Manual Save/Load
　You can save and load at your convenience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/5609db934c9c9e558d42b7894ed4c3bb990bad54.png[/img]

[h3]■ Regarding the Full Release
[/h3]Additionally, we are working on various elements for the full release.

・Battles and Characters
　・Display of action order
　・Damage prediction display
　・Enhanced skill animations for each character
　・Implementation of bond skills
　・Addition of icons to command displays (UI adjustments)
　・Text adjustments for skill descriptions that were unclear
　・Adjustment and enhancement of internal calculation formulas
　・Skill acquisition upon leveling up
　・Gaining trust points upon winning battles

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/f426d0822b8319ed582dc7a34a730463635e9302.png[/img]

・Battlefield
　・Adding map gimmicks
　・Map graphics adjustment
　・Enemy AI adjustment and enhancement
　・Fast-forward feature during enemy phase
　・Improved visibility of bases affected by Stream Airship effects
　・Adding field skills (character skills affecting the battlefield)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/843841cca3c7407c3768ae0f9b2358c131f074a8.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/3acc88107f60a837eb30f64c3bcd7d7eb7a32140.png[/img]

・Other
　・Main Menu Revision and New Features
　　- Adding a feature to review the story's "Summary" from the menu
　　- Adding a section with gameplay tips to the menu
　・Tutorial additions and adjustments
　・Trust story implementation
　・Dead End Theater additions and adjustments
　・Main story expansion and adjustments
　・Map animation additions and adjustments
　・Significant increase in reaction comments

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/0f45705e192ebf3f52e3c919dd41a573366fac78.png[/img]

We will continue and do our best to develope the game!
We hope you enjoy The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily for the coming days.

notes.title: Demo Update Patch v0.1.2
notes.content:
Happy New Year!
We look forward to your continued support in this coming year!

We’re pleased to deliver the “Demo Update Patch v0.1.2 ” we previewed late last year.
Thank you for your patience!

[h3]■ Demo v0.1.2 Update Details
[/h3]
- Difficulty Adjustments
　We have rebalanced the difficulty in the demo stage:
　・Adjusted enemy reinforcements and troop types
　・Adjusted elite enemy strength
　・Adjusted boss enemy strength

- Guard Command Added
　When selecting “Command” in battle, you can now choose the “Guard” option.
　・Guard
　　　Reduces incoming damage. If defense is successful, your party’s MP increases more than usual.

- Target Visibility
　A target marker now appears above enemies.
　You can see which character the enemy is aiming at or whether they are using an area-of-effect attack.

- New Tutorial Scene
　A brief tutorial about the new “Guard” and “Target” mechanics has been added.

- Wave Display Revision
　Wave information is now displayed in “x/3” format.

- Story Skip Button Implemented
　A “Skip” button is now available during story scenes,
　which skips the scene until the next player input is required.

- Phase Progress UI Adjustments
　We have updated the UI to clearly show phase progression each turn.

- “On the Stage” Effects Update
　When streaming, if there is a target you can capture,
　the “On the Stage” effects will now change accordingly.

- Application Optimization
　We have optimized the application to improve game startup speed. 

[h3]■ Changes to Save Data in Demo Update Patch v0.1.2
[/h3]
Due to these updates, save data from Demo v0.1.1 is incompatible with Demo v0.1.2.
　We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.
　(Older save files will no longer be displayed.) 

In the full release, we plan to continue refining the story, optimizing graphics, and implementing features that are currently missing. We will keep working to improve and expand the game. Please try out “Demo v0.1.2” and share your feedback with us. We’ve been enjoying your gameplay streams and videos—thank you for all your support!

Lastly, here is a small preview of upcoming content still in development.
(Note: Screenshots are from a work-in-progress build and may differ in the final product.)

We appreciate your continued support for “The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily.”
Thank you!

[/b]We will re-tune the difficulty of the demo stages:

・Balance enemy spawn frequency and unit types
・Adjust the strength of elite enemies

[/b]In battles, the "Defend" option will be added when selecting "Command."

[b]- Target Visibility
[/b]In battles, targeting will now be visualized when issuing commands, making it clearer which enemy you are aiming for.

The full version will include even more improvements beyond these updates. We encourage you to play the demo and share your thoughts with us.
